visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long black hair, wearing a strapless sparkly gold gown, stands in a dark studio. She holds a silver flute ready to play. Yellow subtitles in Chinese and English appear at the top. The lighting is soft and professional, with warm amber tones behind her. A white musical score with notes is visible at the bottom of the screen. (2) As she begins to play the flute, her fingers move precisely over the keys. Her facial expression is focused yet serene. The editing uses a translucent overlay effect, showing ghosted images of her playing to create a dreamlike atmosphere. The background lighting shifts slightly with hints of purple. The subtitles continue to update with poetic text about the music. (3) She continues her performance, swaying slightly with the rhythm. The camera remains static at eye level, capturing her upper body. The silver flute glints under the studio lights. The musical score at the bottom remains consistent, while the central text provides a narrative in both Chinese and English about the beauty of the moment. (4) In the final phase, she completes the melody and lowers the flute slightly. She looks directly into the camera lens and gives a gentle, warm smile. The background lighting remains dim and atmospheric. A final call to action or encouraging message appears as a text overlay, inviting viewers to enjoy their own golden hour.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 這是一段你可能聽過的旋律. [Subtitle]: You may have heard this epic melody before. [Slogan]: Golden Hour - JVKE (Flute ver.). [Logo]: @lilyflute. (2) [Subtitle]: 但這一次，我讓它變得可以被吹奏，也可以成為你手中的光. [Subtitle]: But this time, I made it playable — so the light can flow through your hands. (3) [Subtitle]: 每一個氣息，都吹出你專屬的節奏；每一段專注，都是黃金時刻的開始. [Subtitle]: Each breath becomes your rhythm. Each moment of focus — the start of a golden hour. (4) [Subtitle]: 這是我的版本，現在，也可以成為你的. [Subtitle]: This is my version. Now it can be yours too. (5) [Subtitle]: 現在，就在這一刻，好好享受屬於你的黃金時光. [Subtitle]: Now, please enjoy your golden hour.
